# Wall-time budgets, in seconds, for each labeled verification stage on the
# hosted runners: ubuntu-24.04 (linux) and macos-15 (macos). `run-check.pl`
# reads this table without changing any stage's status. In CI it records a
# stage over its budget, or one without a row for its host, and the job's
# final verdict step fails on that record; a local run only prints the
# comparison.
#
# A new stage's budget, and every budget recomputed over a new sample of
# runs, is 1.25 times the slowest of the runs recorded in
# research/investigations/test-economy/time-budgets.md, rounded up to 5 s,
# and never under 10 s; that file also records any value the owner set
# directly. AGENTS.md "Checks" says how to judge an overrun. A raise needs
# the owner's approval as a decision in the report and adds 10 s to the
# stage over its budget and to the group stage that contains it, if any;
# lower a budget in the change that makes its stage much faster. "-" marks a
# stage that does not run on that host.

label                           linux  macos  windows

# gate.yml, static group
check/static                    85     125    -
repository-invariants           25     30     -
spec-archives                   10     10     -
readme-translation              10     10     -
spec-prose-integrity            10     10     -
guidance                        10     10     -
source-size                     10     10     -
design-lint                     10     15     -
conformance                     10     10     -
performance-instrument          10     10     -
compiler/lint                   55     75     -

# gate.yml, unit group: the library in test mode, then its cases
check/unit                      315    395    -
compiler/test-build-unit        175    270    -
compiler/test-unit              140    175    -

# gate.yml, corpus group: the ordinary library, the CLI and corpus harnesses,
# then their cases
check/corpus                    305    330    -
compiler/test-build-corpus      135    165    -
compiler/test-corpus            175    175    -

# gate.yml, runtime group
check/runtime                   20     20     -

# io-hosts.yml, completion-linux
linux-runtime                   50     -      -
linux-asan-ubsan                10     -      -
linux-default-tsan              10     -      -
linux-deque-tsan                10     -      -
linux-runtime-tsan              10     -      -

# compute-regression.yml: two cold compiler builds at two Cargo jobs, their
# images, then the host control, the instrument's slowdown and placement
# controls with the shifted images the latter builds, and the paired
# comparison
performance-candidate-compiler  130    -      -
